figures.caption: Figure 1: (a). Single-step parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) mostly performs cross-modal alignment in a single-step manner. (b). Multi-step flow matching (FM) methods model continuous and multi-step alignment dynamics. During the training stage, (c). FMA undergoes a non-uniform angular speed induced by radial–angular coupling. However, (d). DP-FM follows a constant-speed angular geodesic due to decoupled radial and angular dynamics.
